entropy.name: Arrow of Time
entropy.description: Disorder always increases. The longer the colony survives, the stranger spacetime gets.

black_hole.name: Micro Black Hole
black_hole.description: A primordial black hole wanders in. It eats whatever strays too close, and evaporates into Hawking radiation you can harvest.

time_dilation.name: Time Dilation Zone
time_dilation.description: A gravity well drags local proper time. Pawns inside live slower than the rest of the colony.

entropy_surge.name: Entropy Surge
entropy_surge.description: The second law collects its debt: a raid materialises at the colony edge.
